resources.string: Android 13 and newer cannot grant LUCENT access to this legacy file:// link. Ask the sending app to share the video as a content URI, or open it with LUCENT's file picker.
A file name cannot contain / or a null character.
The file name must be 255 UTF-8 bytes or fewer.
Automatic classification uses episode numbering and video duration. Anime is assigned manually because a filename alone cannot reliably distinguish anime from other episodic shows.
Move an anime video to Anime from its video options.
No videos are currently classified as Other.
